verdicts.note: A testable requirement that every displayed list must be introduced by either a lead-in or a heading.
General advice to the writer with no testable threshold for list length (G-5).
Editorial advice to the writer about document flow, not a testable property of text (G-5).
Broad advice about pattern and item length without an actionable threshold (G-5).
Drafting advice based on content context that a checker cannot evaluate (G-5).
A distinct testable requirement that items in a sentence list must be grammatically complete sentences.
A testable capitalisation rule for sentence-list items not covered by A10.
Prescribes visual alignment and typesetting layout, not text.
A specific rule requiring imperative list items without a subject in the lead-in to be styled as full sentences.
An explicit word-count threshold (25 words or less) for run-on fragment sentences (E-4).
About indentation and visual formatting, not text.
Aspirational guidance for the writer ('Ideally...'), not a strict rule (G-5).
A heading that groups child rules and subsections under G-1.
Subjective editorial advice on ordering content for the user (G-5).
A heading that groups its specific child rules A16 to A18 under G-1.
